T: His week at Applebee's. Her week on Cape Cod.
D: Two husbands get a week off from marriage and find out it is not the party they pictured.
P: Serve the riblets when Rick and Fred sink into the food coma at Applebee's.
S: Not the Olive Garden spinach dip
Hot spinach, artichoke and cheese dip with chips. Applebee's, the place to meet women. Apparently.

Baked dip of spinach, artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan, bubbling hot with tortilla chips. Heat the oven to 200C. Wilt 250g baby spinach in a dry pan, squeeze it dry and chop. Mix 250g softened cream cheese, 125g sour cream, 1 crushed garlic clove, 100g grated mozzarella and 40g grated parmesan. Stir in the spinach and 280g drained, chopped marinated artichoke hearts, season and spread in a baking dish. Top with 50g more mozzarella and bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve hot with tortilla chips.
Sticky barbecue pork riblets and pickles. Eat these and you're asleep by nine, hall pass or not.

Pork riblets braised soft, then glazed with a smoky barbecue sauce and grilled sticky, with dill pickles on the side. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub 1.2kg pork riblets with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp brown sugar and salt. Wrap tightly in foil on a tray and bake 2 hours until tender. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill or barbecue on high for 5 minutes a side until sticky and charred at the edges. Serve with dill pickles.
M: Chicken chow mein, soft noodles, cabbage and soy. Nothing fake about this chow.

Soft egg noodles stir-fried with chicken thigh, cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts and spring onion in a soy and sesame sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Cook 400g fresh egg noodles for 1 minute, drain and toss with a little oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot wok with 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 3 cups shredded cabbage, 1 julienned carrot, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, chicken, 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tsp sesame oil and toss hot for 2 minutes. Finish with 2 handfuls of bean sprouts and sliced spring onion.
Lobster in lemon mayo on buttered toasted rolls. Maggie and Grace are having a much better week.

Cape Cod style lobster rolls: cooked lobster meat in a light lemon, chive and celery mayonnaise, piled into split rolls toasted in butter. Chop 500g cooked lobster meat into chunks. Mix with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest and juice of half a lemon, 1 finely diced celery stick, 1 tbsp snipped chives, salt and pepper, and chill. Butter the sides of 4 split hot dog style rolls and toast in a pan until golden. Fill with the lobster and serve with lemon wedges and potato crisps.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies, nothing extra baked in. Gary's batch wrecked a whole round.

Dense, fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a crackly top, cut into squares. Heat the oven to 175C and line a 20cm square tin. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 80g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Spread in the tin and bake 25 to 28 minutes until just set in the middle. Cool completely and cut into 16 squares.
K: Double espresso under silky steamed milk, from the Aussie barista Rick keeps dropping in on.

A proper flat white: a double shot of espresso topped with silky, finely textured steamed milk and only a thin layer of foam. Pull a double espresso into each cup. Steam 600ml full cream milk to about 60C, stretching it only a little so it stays silky. Tap and swirl the jug, then pour into the coffee in a steady stream, finishing with a thin layer of microfoam.

dishes.n: Not the Olive Garden spinach dip
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the dip up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; bake to order

steps.text: Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, squeeze dry and chop.
Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, garlic, most of the mozzarella and the parmesan, then stir in the spinach and artichoke.
Spread in a baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and bake at 200C until bubbling.
Serve hot with tortilla chips.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the riblets in foil up to 2 days ahead and chill; glaze and grill to order

steps.text: Rub the riblets with the paprika, garlic powder, sugar and salt.
Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 160C until tender.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill on high until sticky, turning once.
Serve with dill pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead; glaze and grill to order

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Roast at 220C until tender and browned.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Serve with dill pickles.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the chicken and vegetables and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead; stir-fry to order

steps.text: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy and the cornflour.
Cook the noodles for 1 minute, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the cabbage, carrot, garlic and ginger.
Add the noodles, chicken, the rest of the soy, sugar and sesame oil and toss hot.
Finish with bean sprouts and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cube the tofu and slice the vegetables up to 1 day ahead; stir-fry to order

steps.text: Toss the tofu in cornflour and fry golden in the wok, then set aside.
Cook the noodles for 1 minute and drain.
Stir-fry the cabbage, carrot, garlic and ginger.
Add the noodles, tofu, soy, sugar and sesame oil and toss hot.
Finish with bean sprouts and spring onion.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lobster up to 4 hours ahead and keep it cold; toast the rolls to order

steps.text: Chop the lobster and mix with the mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, celery and chives; chill.
Butter the sides of the rolls and toast in a pan until golden.
Fill with the lobster and serve with lemon wedges and crisps.

veg.n: Meanwhile, Cape Cod egg and chive rolls
veg.make_ahead: Boil the eggs up to 2 days ahead; mix and toast to order

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Chop and mix with the mayonnaise, lemon, celery and chives.
Toast the buttered rolls and fill.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight; they cut cleaner the next day

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with the butter.
Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt and spread in a lined 20cm tin.
Bake at 175C until just set, then cool and cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Best made to order; warm the cups while the machine heats

steps.text: Pull a double espresso into each warm cup.
Steam the milk until silky with only a little foam.
Pour the milk into the coffee in a steady stream.
